measures.what: where the input wires and any solder joints or connectors sit on the back or edge of the disk, and how far they stick out

measures.what: overall length, width, and board thickness, plus the diameter and spacing of the four corner holes

measures.what: total height of components above the top face (ESP32 on headers, capacitor, terminals) and how far pins/solder stick out below the bottom face

measures.what: position and orientation of the USB-C port relative to the perfboard (height from perfboard top face, distance from perfboard edges/centre), plus dimensions of the USB-C plug housing that needs to fit

measures.what: head diameter, shaft diameter, and spacing of the two screws the box will hang on
measures.reply: wall screws size: #8 round-head screws in 1/4 inch anchors; I bought ones with heads 9 mm across at most; wall screws spacing: I can put them wherever you say

measures.what: where the input wires attach on the disk (back face or edge, distance from edge/centre, and height of any solder joints or connector on the back)

measures.what: positions and heights of the capacitor and screw terminals on the perfboard, and how far solder joints stick out underneath the perfboard
measures.reply: perfboard size: 50 x 70 mm; perfboard corner holes: 2.4 mm across, and 0.9 mm from the edge of each hole to the board's edge; perfboard grid: 18 x 24 holes at 2.54 mm; perfboard thickness: I can't measure that

measures.what: which side/end of the perfboard the USB-C port faces, which of the two USB-C ports you plug into, and the port's height and width on the ESP32 board
measures.reply: esp32 size: 63.17 long and 28.25 wide mm; esp32 height: it stands about 16 mm above the perfboard in its female headers; 11.05 mm of that is to the underside of its board; esp32 usb port: 4.80 mm from the outside of its USB-C port to the nearest edge of the ESP32 board, and 7.53 mm from the ESP32's edge to the perfboard's edge

measures.what: width, thickness, and length of the plastic overmold around the USB-C plug
measures.reply: I can't measure that. Use your best judgment.
